audit.checks_scope: schema, fixed profile counts, hourly lengths, zero spinning reserve, foreign keys, cost points, startup tiers, initial status/power

boundary: Package and input checks only; historical solve records retain their original run identities.
source_comparison_scope: Existing local archived gzip, not a new upstream download.

independent_review_this_round.scope: Original gzip/unpacked/current hashes, exact source values and order, full embedded notice, four-file package, Python syntax, 20/50 default audit and temporary CSV exports, existing input tests. No new solve or historical-result revalidation.

license_distribution: Full original copyright, permission notice and disclaimer retained verbatim in input.json LICENSE; duplicate standalone copy removed.
